pages.title: Vendor List
pages.summary: Ledgerline's DPA is not signed and no one is assigned to run required security reviews for new vendors touching customer data.
pages.body:
| vendor | what | contract owner | renews | touches customer data | security review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AWS | hosting (us-west-2) | Felix Arrowood | 2027-02-01 | yes | done 2026-01 |
| Ledgerline | billing + expenses | Tobias Mbeki | 2026-12-15 | yes | done 2025-11, DPA NOT signed |
| HubSpot | CRM, price books, quotes | Marisol Quint | 2027-03-01 | yes (contacts) | done 2026-02 |
| PagerDuty | on-call paging | Dmitri Solberg | 2026-11-30 | no | n/a |
| Kandji | laptop management | Felix Arrowood | 2027-01-10 | no | done 2026-03 |
| Cobaltcare | health insurance | Ines Takahara | 2026-12-31 | no (employee data) | n/a |
| Harlow & Pike | outside counsel | Tobias Mbeki | engagement letter, no renewal | no | n/a |

**Notes:**
- Ledgerline renewal in December: Tobias wants the DPA signed before renewing.
- Any new vendor touching customer data needs a security review first (security policy section 6). Right now nobody is assigned to run those reviews.
